encode_corpus_dense_vectors: run encode_corpus.py to encode a text corpus into dense vector embeddings using a pretrained model
run_predict_embeddings: run the predict function to generate embeddings from a model and dataloader in evaluation mode
build_ctx_encoder_model: build a CtxEncoder or RobertaCtxEncoder model from a pretrained BERT config for context encoding
create_em_dataset: create an EmDataset from a tokenizer and corpus file for batched embedding generation
save_embeddings_numpy: save the generated embedding tensor as a NumPy array to a specified file path
